Record Class SignText

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.minestom.server.item.component.SignText
Record Components:
messages - the four lines, must hold exactly 4 entries
filteredMessages - the four lines as shown to players with chat filtering on, null to show messages to everyone
color - the dye the text is written in
hasGlowingText - whether the text glows in the dark
public record SignText(List<Component> messages, @Nullable List<Component> filteredMessages, DyeColor color, boolean hasGlowingText) extends Record
One text face of a sign.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
